function pair<T extends [number, string?]>(source: T): [number, string?] {
  return [...source];
}
function copyOpen<T extends [string, ...number[]]>(source: T): [string, ...number[]] {
  return [...source];
}
function readonly<T extends readonly [a: number, ...rest: string[]]>(source: T): [number, ...string[]] {
  return [...source];
}
function both<T extends [number] | [number, string]>(source: T): [number, string?] {
  return [...source];
}
function wrapped<T extends readonly [number, ...string[]]>(source: T): [bool: boolean, number, ...string[]] {
  return [false, ...source];
}
console.log(pair([1, 'ready']), copyOpen(['ready', 1, 2]));
console.log(readonly([1, 'a', 'b'] as const), both([2]), wrapped([3, 'c']));

function nested<U extends [number], T extends [...U, string]>(source: T): [number, string] {
  return [...source];
}
function nestedReadonly<U extends readonly [number], T extends readonly [...U, string]>(source: T): [number, string] {
  return [...source];
}
function tagged<T extends [number] & { tag: string }>(source: T): [number] {
  return [...source];
}
function zipped<U extends [number], V extends [string], T extends [...U, ...V]>(source: T): [number, string] {
  return [...source];
}
function choice<T extends ([number] & { tag: string }) | ([string] & { tag: string })>(source: T): [number | string] {
  return [...source];
}
function narrower<T extends [number] & [1]>(source: T): [1] {
  return [...source];
}
console.log(
  nested<[number], [number, string]>([1, 'a']),
  nestedReadonly<readonly [number], readonly [number, string]>([2, 'b']),
  tagged(Object.assign([3] as [number], { tag: 'tag' })),
  zipped<[number], [string], [number, string]>([4, 'd']),
  choice(Object.assign(['choice'] as [string], { tag: 'tag' })),
  narrower([1])
);

function readonlyTagged<T extends readonly [number] & { tag: string }>(source: T): readonly [number] {
  return [...source];
}
function mixed<T extends [number] & readonly [1]>(source: T): [number] {
  return [...source];
}
function readonlyMixed<T extends [number] & readonly [1]>(source: T): readonly [1] {
  return [...source];
}
function readonlyChoice<T extends [number] | (readonly [string] & { tag: string })>(source: T): readonly [number | string] {
  return [...source];
}
console.log(
  readonlyTagged(Object.assign([5] as const, { tag: 'tag' })),
  mixed([1]),
  readonlyMixed([1]),
  readonlyChoice(Object.assign(['six'] as const, { tag: 'tag' }))
);
